questions.prompt: The graph below shows radio and television audiences throughout the day in 1992. Write a report for a university lecturer describing the information shown below. Write at least 150 words.

Museums and art galleries should concentrate on local works of art, not showing the cultures or artworks from other countries. To what extent do you agree? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
